notes: Page states traditional heating/cooling systems are no longer manufactured under the AAF or AAF-McQuay brand names. Parent chain per page: AAF International and AAF-Flanders, subsidiaries of Daikin Industries (McQuay International and AAF International acquired by Daikin in 2006; McQuay name dropped 2013). Style 3 (1971-1995) is HELD, NOT SHIPPED: its year (2nd character, a letter) and month (3rd character) mappings live only in the chart image AAF_McQuay-Style-3.png, which text fetch cannot read. Style 2 month is likewise held (chart image AAF_McQuay-Style-2.png); only its era-bounded year is shipped.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-based: year = 5th & 6th characters, week = 7th & 8th characters, converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example shown spaced as 'AUB U 08 05 00386'; normalized form used here. Year/week values are derived from the stated positions, not page-stated for this example.

Year is the 2nd character, a single digit, encoded as an explicit digit-keyed table bounded by the page-stated 1995-1999 era (single-digit-year policy: no computed decade rule; digits outside 5-9 cannot occur under this era and are not in the table). Month is the 3rd character (a letter) but its mapping is chart-image-only (AAF_McQuay-Style-2.png), so this style ships year-only and the month is held for the image pass. Page attests the example in two lengths: the format list gives '55A1234501' (10 characters) while the style heading gives '55A123501' (9 characters); the pattern accepts 6-7 trailing digits to cover both attested lengths, and the list form is used as the example.
